info.name: BeautyNest Full API Suite (v1.0)
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for BeautyNest — encompassing Customer REST API, Worker/Beautician REST API, and Admin Control Panel endpoints with dynamic JWT & session token management.

item.name: 1. Customer API
item.description: Endpoints consumed by the BeautyNest Customer Mobile App. Simplified booking flow: Login → Pick City → Pick Date (next 7 days) → Pick Time Slot → Address → Confirm Booking (COD or online).

request.description: Refreshes the access token. Accepts refresh_token in body or Bearer token in Authorization header.
Web endpoint — sends a password reset email with a 2-hour valid token link. Check the Rails logs in development to get the reset URL.
Web endpoint — replaces the user's password. Replace PASTE_TOKEN_HERE with the token from the reset email link (visible in Rails logs in development).
Returns current authenticated user: name, email, phone, role, avatar_url.

item.name: Categories & Services
item.description: Browse the service catalog. Start with categories, drill into subcategories, then view services.

request.description: Lists subcategories with their services for the chosen category.
Returns full service details with effective price for the chosen city.

query.description: Search keyword for debouncing search-as-you-type (matches name, description, tags, category, subcategory)

request.description: Debounced live search endpoint for mobile & web search bars. Returns matching services ordered by relevance, with effective pricing, ratings, and category details. Publicly accessible without auth token.
Standalone alias for services search. Publicly accessible.

query.description: Returns trending / featured services when search bar is focused before typing

request.description: Returns popular services to display as search recommendations when user focuses the search input before typing.

item.name: Booking Flow (Cart → Checkout)
item.description: Complete end-to-end booking journey via the cart. Step 1 — choose city → Step 2 — pick date → Step 3 — pick time slot → Step 4 — manage address → Step 5 — view cart → Step 6 — add service(s) to cart → Step 6b — update / remove items → Step 7 — (optional) validate coupon → Step 8 — checkout from cart. Worker is auto-assigned by the backend.

request.description: Returns admin-configured cities where BeautyNest operates. Customer picks one city to begin booking.

query.description: City ID or slug from Step 1

request.description: Returns the next 7 days with availability status. is_available: true means at least one specialist is on duty that day.

exec: var avail = dates.find(function(d) { return d.is_available; }) || dates[0];

request.description: Returns 8 standard time slots (09:00 AM – 07:30 PM). is_available: true means at least one worker is free at that slot.

exec: var avail = slots.find(function(s) { return s.is_available; }) || slots[0];

request.description: Returns saved addresses. Pick one address_id to pass during checkout.
Add a new delivery address inline. The test script auto-saves the new address ID.
Returns the current cart with all items, quantities, unit prices, line totals, and cart subtotal. Use to review what's in the cart before or after adding items.
Adds a service to the cart. If the service already exists the quantity is incremented. Accepts service UUID or slug as service_id. Repeat this call to add multiple services.
Updates the quantity of a specific cart item. Setting quantity ≤ 0 automatically removes the item.
Permanently removes one specific item from the cart.
Removes all items from the cart in one request. The cart record is preserved for future use.
Validates a coupon code and returns the discount amount before checkout. Pass the validated code as coupon_code in Step 8.

Converts the cart into a confirmed booking. Picks up all variables set by Steps 1–7. Backend auto-assigns an available worker, computes server-side pricing, applies coupon if provided, creates a payment record, and clears the cart on success. Supports: city_id or city (slug), date + time_slot, scheduled_at (ISO 8601), address_id, worker_id / therapist_id, coupon_code, payment_method (cod | online), notes.

item.name: Coupons
item.description: View available promotional coupons and validate coupon codes before checkout.

request.description: Returns all active, non-expired promotional coupons available to customers.
Returns available coupons with calculated discount amounts and is_applicable flags for the specified order amount.
Validates whether a coupon code is valid, active, and applicable for the given amount, returning discount details.
Get detailed terms and discount values for a specific coupon code.

item.name: My Bookings
item.description: View and manage bookings after they have been confirmed.

request.description: Returns full cost breakdown: original service amount + approved on-site extra charges = final_total. Use this to show the customer their updated bill.
Cancels a booking that is still in pending or confirmed status.

item.name: Beauticians & Specialists
item.description: Public endpoints to discover top-rated beauticians, search workers, and view specialist profiles with customer reviews.

query.description: Max number of top specialists (default 10, max 50)
Filter top beauticians by city UUID
Filter by worker tier (bronze, silver, gold)

request.description: Returns highest-rated available beauticians ranked by average customer rating, review count, and experience years.
List all active beauticians with optional city, tier, and availability filters.
Get detailed public profile of a beautician including bio, experience, rating stats, and recent customer reviews.

item.name: Platform Statistics
item.description: Public metrics: total customers, total workers, active workers, completed bookings, ratings, and city-level stats.

query.description: Optional: Filter metrics by city slug (e.g. mumbai, delhi, bangalore)
Optional: Filter metrics by city UUID

request.description: Returns total customers, total workers, active specialists, completed bookings, average platform rating, total services and cities.

item.name: Reviews
item.description: Customer reviews for completed bookings and completed services.

request.description: Submits a review for a completed booking. Updates the assigned worker's rating and connects the primary booked service.
Lists all reviews submitted by the authenticated customer for their bookings.
Submits a review for a specific service. Requires that the authenticated customer has completed a booking for this service (service_status == 'completed').

query.description: Filter reviews by Service UUID or slug (Publicly accessible)

request.description: Retrieves customer reviews for a service. Publicly accessible without authentication.

item.name: Wishlist
item.description: Customer wishlist and favorites management — add/remove services, toggle heart status, check status, and list all wishlisted services.

request.description: Fetch all services saved to the authenticated customer's wishlist with full pricing, category, rating, and duration details.
Add a service to customer's wishlist. Accepts service_id (UUID or slug).
Toggle heart status for a service. If already wishlisted, removes it. If not, adds it.
Quickly check if a specific service is in customer's wishlist (returns in_wishlist boolean).
Remove an item from wishlist using either service_id (UUID or slug) or favorite item ID.
Clear all items from the customer's wishlist.

item.name: 2. Worker API
item.description: Endpoints consumed by BeautyNest Service Partners and Beauticians.

request.description: Refreshes an access token for worker without requiring password re-entry. Returns identical response schema to worker login.

item.name: Extra Charges (On-Site)
item.description: Worker adds extra services/products on-site. Price is auto-fetched from catalog — never sent by client.

request.description: Price auto-fetched from service.base_price. Immediately added to booking total.
Price auto-fetched from product.selling_price. Immediately added to booking total.
Worker manually sets description + amount for a custom charge (e.g. travel fee).

item.description: Browser-session management operations and control panel endpoints.
